mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` (order_no, user_id, shop_id, total_amount, pay_amount, freight_amount, discount_amount, coupon_id, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{shopId}, #{totalAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{freightAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{couponId}, #{status}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `order` WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM `order` WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{status}
